extracted.intended_audience: scientists, academics, and prospective applicants for jobs, scholarships, and society membership (readers of Nature, UK)
extracted.subtask_description: A page of society diary items, institutional announcements, job and studentship adverts, subscription and advertisement instructions published in Nature. It lists eligibility, application, fee, and deadline requirements for appointments, studentships, membership, subscriptions and adverts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subscriptions to 'Nature' (rates)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subscriptions to Nature should be addressed to the Publishers; copies can be obtained through any bookseller or post-free from the Publishers on receipt of the stated postage (6d for British Isles residents, 1d? for abroad — see notice).

rubrics_metrics.name: Charges for advertisements
rubrics_metrics.description: Charges for Advertisements: rates listed per number of lines and by fractional page (table of rates for 'Three Lines in Column', per line after, One-Sixteenth Page, One-Eighth Page, Quarter Page, Half Page, Whole Page).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Heavy type counted as two lines. Cheques and Money Orders payable to MACMILLAN & CO., Limited. Office: ST. MARTIN'S STREET, LONDON, W.C. (detailed rate table printed on page).

rubrics_metrics.name: Advertisement submission deadline for issue
rubrics_metrics.description: Advertisements intended for the issue should reach the Publishers by Tuesday, June 11.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Office of 'Nature' is at St. Martin's Street, London, W.C.; advertisers should note the copy-deadline to ensure inclusion in the specified issue.

rubrics_metrics.name: Royal Society — Mackinnon Research Studentships (eligibility & conditions)
rubrics_metrics.description: There are two Studentships each of the value of £150. One is awarded for research in the group of the Physical Sciences (including Astronomy, Chemistry, Geology, Mineralogy, and Physics); the other for research in the group of the Biological Sciences (including Anatomy, Botany, Palaeontology, Pathology, Physiology and Zoology).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Studentships are awarded annually for one year but are renewable for a second year and, under exceptional circumstances, may be renewed for a third year. The Studentships are restricted to British subjects. Applications must be received not later than the published deadline (applications to be received not later than June [date as printed]) and further particulars and forms of application can be obtained from the Assistant Secretary of the Royal Society, Burlington House, London, W.

rubrics_metrics.name: British Association membership terms (eligibility & fees)
rubrics_metrics.description: No technical qualification is required on the part of an applicant for admission as a Member or as an Associate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Members pay £3 on admission, and £1 for any subsequent year in which they attend an Annual Meeting, without further liability. Associates pay £1 for each Annual Meeting they attend. Ladies are admitted on the same terms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application procedures — official form and testimonials
rubrics_metrics.description: Several appointments and competitions require applications to be made on official forms which must be obtained and returned to the named office by the published deadline; applications must be accompanied by copies of up to three recent testimonials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples on the page: West Riding Education Committee posts and London County Council posts require official forms and three testimonials. Candidates applying by post should enclose a stamped and addressed envelope when requesting forms. Deadlines and return addresses are specified with each appointment notice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Canvassing is disqualifying
rubrics_metrics.description: Canvassing, either directly or indirectly, will be held to be a disqualification for employment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stated explicitly in the London County Council notice; applicants should not attempt direct or indirect solicitation as it will forfeit their application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Islington Day Training College appointments — salary scales and application rule
rubrics_metrics.description: Appointments (e.g., Mistress of Method, Lecturer in Physics, Lecturer in Geography, History, Mathematics, Mistress of Singing, Mistress of Gymnastics) list commencing salaries with stated annual increments and different scales for men and women for some posts (e.g., lecturers: commencing salary £160 a year for men and £130 a year for women, rising by increments to £950).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applications should be made on the official form available from the Clerk to the London County Council, Education Offices, Victoria Embankment, W.C., and must be returned by the published deadline accompanied by copies of three testimonials. Canvassing disqualifies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Borough of Widnes — Senior Mistress (eligibility & appointment conditions)
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants must be graduates of a British University and possess good qualifications in German and one or both of the following subjects: Mathematics, Domestic Science. Initial salary £130–£160 according to previous experience, increasing automatically by £10 per annum to [£?] per annum, and if specially recommended to £240 per annum. Appointment is subject to the approval of the Lancashire Education Committee.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Duties to commence in September next. For form of application (to be returned not later than stated date) send stamped addressed foolscap envelope to the Town Clerk, Widnes. Full particulars given in notice.

rubrics_metrics.name: West Riding Education Department — Secondary Schools (application & testimonial limits)
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications for Assistant Mistress/Master posts must be made on forms obtained from the Education Department (Secondary), County Hall, Wakefield, and returned not later than 9 a.m. Monday, June 17, 1907. Copies of not more than three recent testimonials must be sent with the application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Canvassing will be a disqualification. Specific posts and salaries are listed in the notice; applicants must follow the forms and deadlines exactly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Royal College of Surgeons in Ireland — Post-graduate courses (dates & fee)
rubrics_metrics.description: Post-Graduate Courses 1907 are conducted twice a year in June and September. The first course will begin on Monday, June 10 and end on July 6; the second course will begin on September 23 and end on October 15. Fee: Five Guineas.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Further information can be obtained from, and all applications are to be addressed to, Professor Fraser, Royal College of Surgeons, Dublin.

rubrics_metrics.name: University of Manchester — Junior Demonstrator application (stipend & deadline)
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications are invited for the post of Junior Demonstrator of Physiology. The stipend will be £100, rising to £150 per annum.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applications should be sent by June 14 to the Registrar, from whom further particulars may be obtained.
